Name: Compatibility Patch for Rose's Cruelty Free Meat and Animal Husbandry
Author: Kaazkulaas
Description: Small Content Patcher pack to edit the crop drops and cooking recipes from Rose's Cruelty Free Meats to use the item ids for meat from Animal Husbandry where applicable. Includes chicken, beef, pork, rabbit, duck, mutton, and ostrich. [color=#f1c232]Please note[/color], any currently growing meat plants will still drop the meats using the item ids from Rose's Cruelty Free Meats so you will have to replace them for them to start dropping the meats using the Animal Husbandry ids!
